text: Meter? Meter is decoration, saar. Like the Ejipura flyover.
name: Manju Anna

text: Koramangala? Barolla. Indiranagar? Barolla. Where do I go? Home, saar.
name: Manju Anna

text: In 2099 they gave us hover autos. Still no parking. Still Silk Board.
name: Manju Anna

text: You want to go somewhere? Press M, take Namma Metro. Faster than me. Do not tell anyone I said.
name: Manju Anna

text: Coffee kudi, magu. Strong, with froth. Not that ₹400 cold brew nonsense.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Oota aayta? You look thin. These startup people never eat on time.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Idli, vada, kesari bath. Menu has not changed since 1962. Why change perfection?
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Bro, we're pre-revenue but post-vibes.
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: I'm not unemployed, I'm in stealth mode.
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: My co-founder? He is in Koramangala. Every co-founder is in Koramangala.
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: Shhh.
name: Silent Sita

text: …(turns a page very loudly)
name: Silent Sita

text: Shhh. This is a silent reading event. You may wave.
name: Silent Sita

text: EE SALA CUP NAMDE! …What do you mean we already won? Say it louder anyway!
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: I have been chanting since 2008. My throat has its own fan club.
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: Bring a friend and play Catch the Six with me. More hands, more catches.
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: Vidhana Soudha: 1956, granite, neo-Dravidian. Bigger than your rent agreement.
name: Guide Gowramma

text: The inscription says "Government work is God's work". Both move in mysterious ways.
name: Guide Gowramma

text: Cubbon Park is 300 acres. In my time we called it "the lungs of the city". Now we call it "parking for walkers".
name: Guide Gowramma

text: Weekdays I am a Senior Product Manager. Weekends I drive Rapido. For the stories.
name: Rapido Rakesh

text: My placard says "LOOKING FOR 2BHK IN INDIRANAGAR". The camera found me before a landlord did.
name: Placard Pradeep

text: Ten months deposit. TEN. I could buy a hover-auto with that. A used one. From Manju.
name: Placard Pradeep

text: In my time all this was lakes and fields. Now it is lakes in the roads.
name: Uncle with Opinions

text: You know what this city needs? One more flyover. Then everything will be fine. Trust me.
name: Uncle with Opinions

text: Weather is still the best in India. Do not argue with me.
name: Uncle with Opinions

text: Can you hear me? … You're on mute. … No, YOU are on mute.
name: Techie on a Call

text: Sorry, I'm in traffic. I am always in traffic. My manager thinks traffic is my location.
name: Techie on a Call

text: Let's take this offline. I am offline. I am literally on the footpath.
name: Techie on a Call

text: Chai? Coffee? Bun-maska? Life advice? All ₹15.
name: Chaiwala Chandru

text: Oota aayta? Had your meal? … No? Then have a vada at least.
name: Chaiwala Chandru

text: 10-minute delivery! Already 40 minutes. The other 30 minutes were the traffic's fault.
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: Customer said "leave at door". Which door? There are 400 doors in this building.
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: I have been directing traffic here since 2071. The traffic has not noticed.
name: Constable Thimmappa

text: Signal is green. Signal is red. Nobody moves. Same same.
name: Constable Thimmappa

text: Crossing on foot is fastest. Do not tell the cars, they will feel bad.
name: Constable Thimmappa

text: Standup started 40 minutes ago. I am still standing up. In an auto.
name: Tejas in the Auto

text: My manager asked for an ETA. I said "Silk Board". He understood.
name: Tejas in the Auto

text: Road on the bottom, metro on top. Double-decker! Next we will add a third deck. For the traffic to wait in.
name: Engineer Manjula

text: Kadlekai! Cucumber! Phone chargers! Everything you need for the 2-hour journey of 3 kilometres.
name: Snack Seller Sunil

text: Business is good. Silk Board is the best restaurant location in India.
name: Snack Seller Sunil

text: 10-minute delivery! The 10 minutes start when I feel like it.
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: Customer wrote "near the tree". This is Bengaluru. There are 40 lakh trees.
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: My startup is "LinkedIn for cows". The cows are not on LinkedIn yet. Huge market.
name: Founder Farah

text: I have 3 advisors, 2 interns and 0 users. Classic.
name: Founder Farah

text: I only invest in founders who wake up at 4 AM. I wake up at 11. It is called conviction.
name: Angel Anand

text: What is your burn rate? … No, your personal burn rate. How many cold brews per day?
name: Angel Anand

text: In 1985 this was all coconut groves. Now it is all "cohorts".
name: Jayanna Uncle

text: My son is a founder. I ask him "what do you make?" He says "impact". I ask "how much?" He says "pre-revenue".
name: Jayanna Uncle

text: Indiranagar flats are like Silk Board: everyone wants in, nobody moves.
name: Broker Babu

text: 1BHK, 1BHK… ah! A 1RK. Room, kitchen, and the kitchen is also the room.
name: Broker Babu

text: Tonight: indie folk-rock-fusion-lofi. Genre? Bengaluru.
name: Gig-night Gautam

text: We have played every pub on 12th Main. Some of them even paid us.
name: Gig-night Gautam

text: Day 214 of looking for a 2BHK in Indiranagar. The landlord asked for my horoscope.
name: Placard Pradeep

text: I carry 18 plates of dose on one arm. My physiotherapist carries 19. Competition.
name: Seenappa

text: Masala dose, khara bath, kesari bath, coffee. That is the whole menu. Since 1943. Perfect things do not change.
name: Seenappa

text: Our Nandi is carved from one single rock. Still growing, they say. Like rents.
name: Archak Acharya

text: Kadalekai Parishe in November: the groundnut fair. Farmers offer their first crop to Basavanna.
name: Archak Acharya

text: Lalbagh: 240 acres, 1,800 species, and one man doing yoga loudly every morning.
name: Gardener Gangamma

text: The rock here is 3,000 million years old. Older than the Pink Line deadline.
name: Gardener Gangamma

text: The foam is a mix of detergent, sewage and bad decisions. In 2099 it became… self-aware.
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: Bellandur used to be the biggest lake in the city. It still is. It just has extra layers now.
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: My office is 4 km away. I leave at 8. I reach at 10. I have read 70 books in traffic this year.
name: ORR Oviya

text: When it rains, the Outer Ring Road becomes the Outer Ring River. We have boats now. Hover boats.
name: ORR Oviya

text: So many buses! How does anyone know which one? … By asking 14 people, I suppose.
name: Lost Lakshmi

text: My son said "take the metro". The metro took me to Majestic. Majestic took my sanity.
name: Lost Lakshmi

text: Everyone in Bengaluru came through Majestic once. Some of them are still looking for the exit.
name: Coolie Krishna

text: Platform 7? Go straight, left, right, up, down, ask again.
name: Coolie Krishna

text: The benne masala dose is crisp outside, soft inside, butter everywhere. The queue is the seasoning.
name: CTR Chandrashekar

text: No, we do not take reservations. We take patience.
name: CTR Chandrashekar

text: Idli so soft you can sleep on it. Chutney so good you will forget your ex.
name: Veena Stores Venkatesh

text: Eat standing. Sitting is for people with time.
name: Veena Stores Venkatesh

text: Badge?
name: Security Shivanna

text: Laptop declaration?
name: Security Shivanna

text: Badge AND laptop declaration?
name: Security Shivanna

text: Training starts at 9. I came at 6. My bus came at 5. I live in the bus now.
name: Fresher Fathima

text: They said "campus". They did not say it is bigger than my hometown.
name: Fresher Fathima

text: Since the metro reached Whitefield, my commute is 1 hour. Before it was 2. I have so much free time I started a podcast.
name: Commuter Kiran

text: Whitefield: half tech park, half forest, all traffic.
name: Commuter Kiran

text: Saar! New in Bengaluru, ah? I can tell. You are looking at the weather like it owes you money.
name: Manju Anna

text: Where to?
name: Manju Anna

text: Koramangala? Barolla, saar. Traffic. … Okay okay. Meter mele fifty.
name: Manju Anna

text: But first, magic words. Without these you will not survive one day here.
name: Manju Anna

text: "Swalpa adjust maadi." Please adjust a little. Bus full? Swalpa adjust maadi. Auto full? Swalpa adjust maadi. Life? Swalpa adjust maadi.
name: Manju Anna

text: Go! Say it to three strangers on the footpath. Watch the magic.
name: Manju Anna

text: See? Three people adjusted. Now you are ten percent Bengalurean.
name: Manju Anna

text: The other ninety percent is sitting in traffic. You will get there.
name: Manju Anna

text: Tip: press R and your hover scooter comes. Press M for Namma Metro to other areas. And talk to Ajji near Koshy's — she needs help.
name: Manju Anna

text: Meter? *looks at meter like it is a museum piece* Meter mele fifty, saar.
name: Manju Anna

text: Exploring! Good, good. Today exploring, tomorrow paying ₹45,000 rent in Indiranagar.
name: Manju Anna

text: Magu! Thank God. My delivery boy took the order to Silk Board in 2087. He is still in the queue.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Three regulars are waiting for coffee. Filter coffee must be HOT. Cold filter coffee is a crime in this state.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Can you run? Or ride your scooter, I don't care.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Coffee! I have a standup in 2 minutes. Standups here last 2 hours.
name: Anxious Ananya

text: Ah, decoction! Correct ratio. You may enter Basavanagudi now.
name: Professor Prasad

text: Bro, is this keto? … Who cares. Filter coffee is a lifestyle.
name: Gym Bro Girish

text: All three, still hot? You are faster than 10-minute delivery. You are 9-minute delivery.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Learn this: "Banni, coffee kudiyona" — come, let's have coffee. Fixes every problem in Bengaluru.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: For you? Free coffee for life. And my blessings. Blessings are worth more than ESOPs, magu.
name: Kamalamma Ajji

text: Shhh. Welcome to Cubbon Reads. Every Saturday, hundreds of us sit under the trees and read. Silently.
name: Silent Sita

text: Sit on the grass (Q → Sit) and do not move for 25 seconds. Whatever happens.
name: Silent Sita

text: …You did it. You read a book. In public. Without checking your phone. You are ready for anything.
name: Silent Sita

text: Take this phrase: "Ond nimsha" — one minute. In Bengaluru it can mean anything from one minute to one year.
name: Silent Sita

text: EE SALA— oh, hello. Crisis. My five lucky flags blew away. Without them the team cannot perform. Science.
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: They are all around the stadium. One is up on the stands, I think. You can climb, no? Jump into a wall and climb!
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: GOOSEBUMPS! I am crying. Do not look. Here, the most powerful phrase in Karnataka is now yours.
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: Come back with friends and talk to me for Catch the Six!
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: Catch the Six! I hit, you catch. Everyone nearby can join. Ready?
name: Ee Sala Eshwar

text: Hover race through the streets! Checkpoints, no traffic rules (as usual). Everyone nearby can join.
name: Rapido Rakesh

text: Tourist? Welcome to Vidhana Soudha! Want to see inside? Just get this visitor form stamped.
name: Guide Gowramma

text: Three counters only. Very fast. Very modern. Since 2099 we have even switched off the fax machine. Mostly.
name: Guide Gowramma

text: Form? Where is the Xerox copy? Two copies. Self-attested. Go to the High Court shop for Xerox.
name: Counter 1

text: Xerox? Light illa. Power cut. Come after lunch. … Joking! ₹2 per page. Ninety rupees.
name: Xerox Uncle

text: Copies, very good. Now stamp from Counter 2. Counter 2 is… on lunch. Wait here.
name: Counter 1

text: *THUMP* Stamped. Your file will be processed in 2 to 3 business years. Next!
name: Counter 2

text: Only one hour?! A record! The Chief Minister himself would be jealous.
name: Guide Gowramma

text: When you leave somewhere, never say "bye". Say "Hogi banni" — go and come back.
name: Guide Gowramma

text: Bro. BRO. A VC is here in this very cafe. I have 90 seconds. Help me craft the pitch.
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: First line. What are we building?
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: Business model?
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: Moat?
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: Close it. Say something visionary.
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: Interesting. Let's circle back. Ping me on LinkedIn. (She will not reply.)
name: VC Vasundhara

text: It's fine, bro. Pivoting is a lifestyle. We are now… a podcast.
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: Pre-revenue. Pre-product. Pre-team. … I love it. Here's ₹100 crore at a ₹1000 crore valuation.
name: VC Vasundhara

text: MACHA! SAKKATH! We're a unicorn! Next stop: a ₹400 cold brew to celebrate.
name: Pitch-Deck Prateek

text: You want to cross Silk Board? Brave. Very brave. People have entered this junction as freshers and left as team leads.
name: Constable Thimmappa

text: Reach the other side in 70 seconds. On foot. Weave between the vehicles — they are not going anywhere anyway.
name: Constable Thimmappa

text: You made it?! *takes off cap* In 2083 a man tried. They say he is still on the median, selling kadlekai.
name: Constable Thimmappa

text: Take this phrase. You will use it every day for the rest of your life: "Traffic, late aagutte" — traffic, I will be late.
name: Constable Thimmappa

text: Bro. BRO. Laptop at 3 percent. I am presenting the quarterly roadmap in 4 minutes. From this auto.
name: Tejas in the Auto

text: I need a charger and a coffee. The snack guy has chargers. There is a darshini on the corner. Please. My career depends on you.
name: Tejas in the Auto

text: *plugs in* *sips* "…and that is why Q3 is a growth quarter." *unmutes* They loved it. They think I am in a cafe. I am in an auto. At Silk Board.
name: Tejas in the Auto

text: Saar, meter is at ₹890. We moved 40 metres.
name: Auto driver

text: Bengaluru's first double-decker: road below, metro above. Take your hover scooter up the ramp and ride it end to end.
name: Engineer Manjula

text: Press R for your scooter. And please do not try to ride on the metro deck. We have had… incidents.
name: Engineer Manjula

text: Smooth! Only you and the pigeons have used it without traffic. Welcome to the future.
name: Engineer Manjula

text: Macha! I have 3 orders and my scooter is stuck at the Sony World signal. The app says "10 minutes". The app lies, but customers believe it.
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: Pick up at the dark store, then drop in Koramangala blocks. Use your hover scooter. In app time you have 10 minutes. In real time… 2 and a half.
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: All three in time?! You are the reason the app says 10 minutes. Here, my most used Kannada phrase: "Bega baa!" — come fast!
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: I need a technical co-founder. Requirements: knows "AI", works for equity, and believes cows deserve LinkedIn.
name: Founder Farah

text: There are four techies in the cafes around here. Go recruit one. Warning: they are all already founders.
name: Founder Farah

text: Sorry, I'm building "Tinder for flatmates". We pivot every Tuesday.
name: Pivot Pavan

text: Is it on the blockchain? No? Then it doesn't exist.
name: Blockchain Bhavana

text: I founded 6 startups this year. I just want to sleep. Is sleep a startup?
name: Burnout Bharath

text: Cows on LinkedIn… with endorsements for "grazing"? … I'm in. But I want my name first on the pitch deck.
name: Debug Deepa

text: Deepa said YES? We are a TEAM! Next: a WhatsApp group, a logo, and a ₹400 cold brew. Product can wait.
name: Founder Farah

text: "Macha, sakkath!" — that is how you say "dude, awesome" here. Use it liberally. Founders do.
name: Founder Farah

text: Race me through the blocks? Everyone nearby can join.
name: Delivery Dinesh

text: Looking for a flat in Indiranagar? Ha ha. Ha. OK. I have three. Each landlord will interview you. Be your best self. Or someone else's.
name: Broker Babu

text: Veg or non-veg?
name: Landlord Lakshman

text: Deposit is 10 months. Cash. Today.
name: Landlord Lakshman

text: Very good. But I prefer families. You are not a family. Next.
name: Landlord Lakshman

text: Send your LinkedIn and a 500-word essay on "Why Indiranagar".
name: Landlady Leela

text: Visitors after 9 PM?
name: Landlady Leela

text: Your essay was 498 words. Rejected.
name: Landlady Leela

text: Rent ₹62,000. Maintenance ₹8,000. "Lift charges" ₹2,000 (no lift).
name: Landlord Lokesh

text: Pets?
name: Landlord Lokesh

text: Ok ok. You said "adjust maadi". You are one of us. Flat is yours. Rent increases 15% every year. Welcome home!
name: Landlord Lokesh

text: Congratulations! Now, my brokerage: two months rent. What? I said "no brokerage". The asterisk said otherwise.
name: Broker Babu

text: When the landlord asks anything you cannot answer, say "Gottilla" — I don't know. Works every time.
name: Broker Babu

text: You smiled too much in your profile photo. Suspicious.
name: Landlady Leela

text: Come with your parents. Grandparents also. Next.
name: Landlord Lakshman

text: Gig in 3 minutes and my band has vanished. Drummer, guitarist, singer. Classic Indiranagar Friday.
name: Gig-night Gautam

text: Drummer is always in a cafe. Guitarist went to "check something" on a rooftop. Singer is stuck in traffic somewhere close.
name: Gig-night Gautam

text: SUPER, MAGA! The crowd loved it. Mainly because there was a free shot of filter coffee.
name: Gig-night Gautam

text: Rush hour! Sunday morning, the queue goes to the next street. I need help serving.
name: Seenappa

text: Carry this stack of dose plates to three tables. Walk smoothly. No running, no sudden turns. Respect the dose.
name: Seenappa

text: You served 7 plates! Customers are asking for you by name. I am a little jealous.
name: Seenappa

text: In Bengaluru we do not say hello. We say "Oota aayta?" — had your meal? Correct answer is always "Aaytu!"
name: Seenappa

text: Long ago a bull ate all the groundnut crops here. The farmers prayed, and the bull became stone: our Nandi. Every year we offer the first groundnuts.
name: Archak Acharya

text: The crows have scattered the offering around Bugle Rock and the temple. Gather 12 handfuls before the evening aarti.
name: Archak Acharya

text: Blessings! May your rent never increase and your auto always say yes.
name: Archak Acharya

text: Stay back! The foam has gained consciousness. It has opinions. It wants the Outer Ring Road.
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: Take this Clean-up Cannon. Aim at the foam and click (or tap ✋). Hit its blobs before they splat you.
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: Ready?
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: You did it! The foam has retreated to… a smaller foam. Science is incremental.
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: Look at that sky. "Bengaluru weather, ayyo!" — say it with a sigh of pride.
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: Insurance covers "acts of God". This is an act of detergent. So, no.
name: Dr. Kere Kavitha

text: Meeting at Ecoworld in 90 seconds and I am at Ecospace. On the ORR that is… two business days.
name: ORR Oviya

text: Ride there for me and show my badge at the gate. The security guard trusts badges more than faces.
name: ORR Oviya

text: Excuse me! I need bus 500-D to go to my son in Whitefield. He works in "IT". I don't know what that means but he pays for my phone.
name: Lost Lakshmi

text: Thank you, kanna! If the bus doesn't come, I will take an auto. How do I talk to the auto man?
name: Lost Lakshmi

text: "Meter haaki, anna" — put the meter, brother. Say it firmly. Then pay meter-mele-fifty anyway.
name: Lost Lakshmi

text: Saar! A passenger forgot his suitcase at the bus stand and his train leaves KSR in 75 seconds. I am 63 years old. You are not.
name: Coolie Krishna

text: You want a benne masala dose? Join the queue. It moves. Slowly. Like tectonic plates.
name: CTR Chandrashekar

text: A man walks straight to the front.
name: The Queue

text: Someone asks if you are "in the queue or just standing".
name: The Queue

text: A techie asks you to "hold his spot for 2 minutes".
name: The Queue

text: *adjusts to the back of the line* …Sorry, sorry.
name: Line-cutter

text: See? The queue is a test. You passed. "Swalpa adjust maadi" — you know this already. Now you mean it.
name: CTR Chandrashekar

text: *everyone nods wisely*
name: The Queue

text: Hi! It's my first day. I need: my badge from Gate 6, a laptop declaration, and lunch. Training starts in 3 minutes!
name: Fresher Fathima

text: Badge! Form! Curd rice! I am officially an employee. Next goal: retire.
name: Fresher Fathima

text: Shuttle race? Unofficial. Very unofficial. Everyone nearby can join.
name: Security Shivanna

text: Last metro to MG Road leaves Kadugodi in 2 minutes! If I miss it I have to take an auto. Do you know what an auto costs from Whitefield? A kidney. Two kidneys after 10 PM.
name: Commuter Kiran

text: *panting* Made it! When you leave somewhere here, say "Hogi banni" — go and come back. We always come back. Rent is paid.
name: Commuter Kiran

text: Quiz night, dance-off, chor-police. Something is always on here!
name: Meetup Mamta

text: Bring your friends, macha. More people, more fun.
name: Meetup Mamta

text: Ee beat, macha! Feel it!
name: DJ Dinesh

text: Next track is a banger, trust me.
name: DJ Dinesh

text: Who wants a drop?
name: DJ Dinesh

text: Which lake makes foam? Easy one. Tonight's questions are harder.
name: Quizmaster Krishna

text: Fastest fingers in Bengaluru, step up!
name: Quizmaster Krishna

text: Strong filter kaapi! Wakes up even Silk Board traffic.
name: Kaapi Kumar

text: Kaapi, saar? Ten coins only.
name: Kaapi Kumar

text: New shades just arrived from Commercial Street!
name: Boutique Bhavana

text: Look sharp at the club, darling.
name: Boutique Bhavana

text: Namaskara, I'm DJ Dinesh! Want me to drop the bass? Everyone dancing on the floor gets a bonus.
name: DJ Dinesh

text: Fancy a quiz? Eight questions on Namma Bengaluru. Faster answers score more.
name: Quizmaster Krishna

text: Filter kaapi, saar! Ten coins. Strong enough to make you run thirty percent faster.
name: Kaapi Kumar

text: Welcome to Bhavana's Boutique! Shades, jasmine, gold chains, and titles everyone can see.
name: Boutique Bhavana

text: A meetup is about to start! Want in?
name: Meetup Mamta

text: Namaskara! I run the meetups here. Quiz nights, dance-offs, chor-police and blaster battles. What shall we do?
name: Meetup Mamta
